Subject: AWS co-sell: Citadell Health handoff + sprint plan

Hi Amit & Rachel —

Thanks again for the intro and for taking the time with the AWS team. Per our call earlier this week, the goal from Redwood side is to get a tight 2-week kickoff/sprint so we can scope a small pilot: cost-sensitive data-inference on Citadell's in-clinic triage workflow.

I’ve looped in Laura (Solutions) and Karthik (Partner PM) from Redwood and Suresh from AWS to coordinate the co-sell handoff and the technical/ops sprint. Attached is a draft joint-account sprint plan and an account map that we suggested during the call.

Proposed next steps:
- Week 0: mutual intro + alignment call (30m) — confirm success metrics and legal/proc runway
- Week 1: infra & data readiness check (Redwood + Citadell + AWS SA)
- Week 2: small proof-run with synthetic subset + performance/cost baseline

Can you share availability for a 30m alignment call next week? Also please confirm the primary technical contact on your side (who can share brief infra notes).

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

Attachment: citadell-account-map.xlsx (xlsx, 22KB)

Hi Amit / Rachel —

Thanks — I attached a slightly updated sprint plan that breaks out owner tasks and deliverables. Short summary of the plan (attached doc):
- Day 0 (alignment): confirm success metrics (latency <= 300ms p95 on a 256-token prompt, initial cost baseline) and legal PO timeline
- Day 1–3: data & network readiness (VPN/peering checklist, sample dataset, retention settings) — owner: Citadell (Michael) + Karthik (Redwood)
- Day 4–8: infra provision + model variant testing (Redwood + AWS SA) — owner: Laura + Suresh
- Day 9–11: pilot run & baseline reporting — owner: Laura + Citadell ops
- Day 12–14: readout and next-steps (rollout vs expand scope)

Can Laura/Karthik/Vanessa own the deliverables below?
- Karthik: coordinate procurement runway and HubSpot deal updates (we have early procurement questions)
- Laura: run the infra test plan and coordinate with Suresh for any specific AMI/instance tuning
- Vanessa: I’ll need your help on co-sell collateral and the AWS partner intake form.

Please confirm owners. I’ll also add the HubSpot link in the doc.

Attachment: joint-account-sprint-plan.docx (updated)

Laura Bennett
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
